policy.authority: scripts/destination-coverage-check.py enforces this registry; a census writer without an entry, a guarded entry without a live guard call or named regression, and a pinned entry whose bytes drift all fail the check.

classes.guarded: destination checks in-file via destination_capability; negative regression named
classes.package_confined: writes only package-derived paths; sha256-pinned so any change forces re-review
classes.test_only: test/fixture support writing only to caller-supplied test sandboxes or hermetic temp clones; sha256-pinned
classes.excluded: mechanically bounded non-governed writes (see reason); sha256-pinned

scripts/analysis/fixture_infrastructure_.justification: hermetic self-probes: writes only inside tempfile.TemporaryDirectory sandboxes and disposable clones it creates and removes

scripts/analysis/fixture_runner.py.evidence: manifest destination is a package constant (docs/analysis/generated/fixture_manifest.json); no CLI destination argument; --no-write suppresses the only write

scripts/analysis/release_manifest_negati.justification: hermetic negative probes: mutates manifests only inside disposable clone sandboxes it creates and removes

scripts/assignment_fixture_support.py.justification: smoketest fixture scaffolding; invoked only by suites against temp or hermetic staging trees

scripts/assignment_c4_fixture_support.py.justification: C4 fixture support writes only beneath caller-supplied hermetic temporary project roots

scripts/audit/schema.py.reason: write-helper library with no CLI entry; its only writing caller is scripts/audit/run_all.py, which is guarded; sha256 pin forces re-review of any change

scripts/evidence_publication.py.reason: journaled publication, validation, and recovery library with no CLI entry; its writing callers are guarded publishers

scripts/build-plugin.py.evidence: no CLI arguments at all; every write path derives from the package root (bundle under .claude-plugin/, build worktree under .worktrees/)

scripts/c2_evidence_fixture_support.py.justification: C2 fixture support writes only beneath caller-supplied hermetic temporary test roots

scripts/destination-coverage-check.py.evidence: writes only references/destination_coverage_registry.json (package constant) and only under --pin

scripts/hooks/full_run_pretooluse_gate.p.reason: only write is a NamedTemporaryFile in the OS temp directory, unlinked in a finally block; no destination input exists

scripts/semantic_graph_fixture_support.p.justification: smoketest fixture environment support; invoked only by suites against temp or hermetic staging trees

scripts/fixtures/assurance_provenance_c2.evidence: regenerates only the fixed package fixture directory derived from __file__; build intermediates use a temporary directory

scripts/staging_run.py.regression: scripts/shipment_manifest_smoketest.py (refusal outside the lane; ungoverned fail-closed)

scripts/worktree_paths.py.justification: sandbox-base helper for hermetic smoketest clones (sibling of the primary worktree); production writers never route destinations through it
